metadata.title: America Has 989 Billionaires — Where Does YOUR Country Rank? | Top 20 Countries
metadata.description:
America has 989 billionaires. China has 539. India has 229. Where does your country rank?

This is the real ranking of the world's richest countries — sorted by how many billionaires they have, based on the latest Forbes World's Billionaires list. From the obvious superpowers to the small nations punching far above their weight, here's the countdown of the 20 countries with the most billionaires on Earth.

Drop your country in the comments — let's see how many of you made the list.
